components.name: Survey Sheet
components.description: The official plan as a drawing sheet, with a gold frame line and block pins.
components.css: .ds-sheet{position:relative;margin:0;max-width:520px;background:#F3F5F5;border:1px solid #9DB5AF;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px -30px rgba(6,37,42,.35);font:13px 'Schibsted Grotesk',system-ui,sans-serif;color:#4A6B6E}.ds-sheet::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:6px;border:1px solid #D2A746;opacity:.7;pointer-events:none}.ds-sheet figcaption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #C9D8D3}.ds-sheet b{font:400 18px 'Libre Caslon Display',Georgia,serif;color:#0B3A40}.ds-plan{position:relative;height:200px;background:#EAF1EE;margin-top:10px}.ds-pin{position:absolute;left:40%;top:50%;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #B04761;background:#B04761;color:#fff;font:600 15px 'Schibsted Grotesk',sans-serif}

components.css: .ds-card{max-width:470px;display:grid;gap:14px;background:#06252A;color:#EAF1EE;border:1px solid rgba(227,201,141,.22);border-radius:24px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.45);font:16px/1.55 'Albert Sans',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-card h2{font:400 40px/1 Gloock,Georgia,serif;margin:0;color:#fff}.ds-card p{margin:0;color:#C5D1D2}.ds-pill{justify-self:start;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(227,201,141,.55);color:#E3C98D;font:600 12.5px 'Albert Sans',sans-serif}

narrative.overview: Two worlds in one colour standard. The home page is 'Daylight Survey': the official FGEHA plan as a survey sheet on mist, teal ink, gold rule lines, rose only for the call to act and the block in focus. The 3D page (#3d) stays dark (dusk) with teal cards over the plan.
keyCharacteristics: Official plan as a survey sheet on the first screen

rules.name: The One Rose Rule
rules.body: Rose is only for the call to act and the block or plot in focus. WhatsApp is teal, filled.

rules.name: The Honest Sheet Rule
rules.body: The plan is shown as FGEHA issued it: never recoloured or washed; marks sit on top as pins at the printed block labels.

rules.name: The Final Figure Rule
rules.body: Prices and outlook figures show their final values from the first paint; no count-up.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No small label above a heading.
